notes: The scene runtime uses procedural factories. GLB files are portable, equivalent derivatives for reuse and interchange; optional downloads only.
No raster textures are required: handmade surfaces use opaque PBR materials and per-vertex linear colours.
Collision is separately defined, never inferred from decorative foliage. Runtime game rules choose where collision is blocking.
No measured FPS, memory or draw-call result is claimed by this manifest; renderer evidence belongs to independent review.

provenance.creator: Moss & Moon Maker / asset assistant
provenance.rights: Original project-authored procedural geometry and palette. No external model, texture, character or logo source. Three.js is a separately licensed MIT runtime dependency.

spec.lodPolicy: One closed 3D grid geometry, instancing-compatible. Every authored component is retained; rounded parts use 20 triangles, leaves 8 triangles and mushroom caps 48 triangles, with reference primitive bounds preserved. Main and shadow passes use the same geometry.
spec.material: Vertex-colour PBR; vertex RGB stored in linear colour space; metallic 0.035, roughness 0.87; built-in primitive UVs preserved, no texture dependency.
